prompt:
CREATIVE OBJECTIVE
Create a quiet editorial travel memory that remains recognizably grounded in the source photograph.

SOURCE FACTS
- scene.location: Shanghai [user_fact]
- scene.date: 2026-08-12 [user_fact]
- subject.relationships: primary-person is the user [user_fact]
- typography.language: zh-CN [user_content]
- typography.content.title: 夏日散步 [user_content]
- typography.content.subtitle: Shanghai · 2026 [user_content]
- subject.people_count: 1 [observation]
- composition.subject_occupancy: 0.28 [observation]
- composition.negative_space_ratio: 0.46 [observation]
- composition.spatial_relationships: person in lower-left, buildings receding to upper-right [observation]
- color.dominant: red [observation]
- scene.type: city [inference]
- mood.tone: quiet [inference]
- lighting.condition: soft-daylight [inference]

PRESERVATION CONSTRAINTS
- subject.identity for primary-person: hard — Keep the primary person's identity and recognizable facial features.
- scene.landmark: hard — Keep recognizable architecture and landmark silhouettes.
- composition.spatial_relationships: soft — Retain the relationship between person, street, and buildings.

TRANSFORMATION CONSTRAINTS
- composition.framing: required — Reframe the source into an intentional editorial page.
- material.texture: required — Introduce a restrained printed-paper surface.
- typography.content: allowed — Use only user-provided copy.

COMPOSITION
- layout: photo-anchor-with-quiet-field
- negative space: retain-native-quiet-areas
- subject scale: 0.42

VISUAL LANGUAGE
- color strategy: source-palette-with-one-accent
- accent color: muted-blue
- texture: layered-uncoated-paper-with-light-registration-shift
- lighting: preserve-source-light
- mood: observant-and-quiet
- graphic marks: fine-rule, small-location-label

TYPOGRAPHY
- mode: custom
- rendering: model
- language: zh-CN
- title: 夏日散步
- subtitle: Shanghai · 2026

OUTPUT
- aspect ratio: 2:3
- background: opaque

ADDITIONAL CONSTRAINTS
- Do not invent logos, coordinates, dates, locations, or relationships.
